item.title: ProtoQuiz Is THE Tool for Paramedic Students
item.description: In paramedic school you have to learn your ride service's full protocol, and it never matches the NREMT material. ProtoQuiz drills that protocol from the document itself.

item.title: Study Your Medications with AI
item.description: Version 2.6.2: seven days of Premium with no card, Med Mastery hard mode grades what you type against your own protocol, and algorithm quizzes fit your cert level.

item.title: ProtoQuiz for Agencies, Rebuilt: Your Protocol In, One Quiz per Shift Out
item.description: Your agency sends the protocol, we build and check the question bank from it, and crews get one short quiz per shift, cited to your pages and scoped by cert level.

item.title: Medicine Mode Is Live: A Living Textbook for EMS
item.description: 742 evidence-cited topics on the pathophysiology and research behind what we do on the truck, following the patient from dispatch to the ICU.

item.title: ProtoQuiz Update: NREMT Prep Is Now Included - and It's Free
item.description: 1,700+ NREMT questions with per-option rationales, a readiness dashboard, and an adaptive exam simulator that behaves like the real test.

item.title: We Compared 53 EMS Protocols From Across the Country. This Is What We Found.
item.description: Real providers uploaded 53 EMS protocols and we read every page. Starting doses, arrest rules, stroke scales and scope of practice vary more than you would think.

item.title: I Compared 51 EMS Protocols From Across the Country. Here's What I Noticed.
item.description: I looked at 51 EMS protocols from all over the US. Almost every service carries the same 19 drugs — but they don't dose them the same, and what's risky when you switch agencies isn't what you'd expect. Here are the patterns.

item.title: I Built ProtoQuiz for Paramedic School. It's Time to Run It at Your Agency.
item.description: ProtoQuiz started as the tool I needed in paramedic school. Now there is a version for agencies: your protocols, your providers, your dashboard.

item.title: Why We Made ProtoQuiz Fully Free
item.description: Why we dropped daily limits for an ad-supported model in April. Since then the ads are gone, and the free tier is 3 per day of each generated feature.

item.title: How to Study EMS Protocols: A Practical Guide for Medics
item.description: Re-reading your protocol PDF feels productive but does not stick. Active recall, spaced repetition and scenarios do, in 2-3 hours a week.

item.title: Spaced Repetition for EMS: How to Remember Protocols Long-Term

item.title: EMS Pharmacology Study Guide: How to Actually Remember Your Drug Box

item.title: EMS Training Compliance: What Training Officers Actually Need
